text:
andrea: heads-up — severity: P0 for eu-embed customers, high error rate from latest canary (v2.14.3). requesting expedited hotfix deploy and pin to v2.14.2 for eu-west1. need ops approval to skip full canary.
deploybot: deploy request received: service=embed-service region=eu-west1 image=redwood/embed:v2.14.2 target=canary->prod. CI checks: unit ✅, e2e ⚠️ (flaky test), infra checks ✅. Rollback tag: v2.14.2
michael_ops: @andrea can you confirm metric delta and rollback window? what's the blast radius if we fast-track?
andrea: error rate spikes on long inputs only, ~18% ↑ on embeddings pipeline. traffic scope ~5% of eu region. rollback window 15m, we can pin service to v2.14.2 quickly.
sre_oncall: prefer partial traffic shift to 10% then 50% if stable. but ok to fast-track if we keep circuit-breaker ON and metric alert auto-rollbacks enabled.
ops_lead: +1 for expedited. need release note blurb and customer comms draft before prod push. @andrea can you add lines? :memo:
andrea: drafting release note now — will add short blurb and incident link. ETA 5m.
ben_platform: tagging runtime team — ensure kvcache warmup script included in rollout to avoid cold-start spike. snippet:
```
kubectl set image deploy/embed-service embed=redwood/embed:v2.14.2 -n eu-west1
kubectl rollout status deploy/embed-service -n eu-west1 --timeout=5m
```
deploybot: safety checks re-run: infra ✅, kvcache probe ✅, latency OK. Canary 10% initiated.
monitoring_bot: Alert rule: eu.embed.error_rate > 5% for 3m — currently 1.2% after canary start. No auto-rollback triggered.
maria_security: heads-up — no new IAM changes in this image, ok from sec side.
michael_ops: approving expedited deploy to 50% then full if metrics hold. approve: michael_ops :thumbsup:
zach_dev: pinned docker tag v2.14.2 in rollout config and updated deploy manifest. pushing config now.
andrea: release note posted: "hotfix: pin embed-service to v2.14.2 to mitigate long-input encoding error; rollback criteria: error_rate >5% sustained 3m or latency >2s p95" link: https://internal.releases/redwood/notes/1709523456-hotfix
deploybot: canary -> 50% traffic shift complete. No regression at 10m.
sre_oncall: monitoring healthy. proceed to 100% in 10m unless concerns.
ops_lead: final sign-off to complete expedited window. approve: ops_lead ✅
deploybot: rollout complete: 100% traffic on v2.14.2 in eu-west1. post-deploy checks pass. mark: expedited-hotfix/1709523456
andrea: filing postmortem and action items for test flakiness. thanks all. :heart:
michael_ops: note — ensure we update canary test to cover long-input scenario before next release.
andrea: will add to backlog. closing thread.
